scope.ja: 主要24手法の問題設定・採用変種・使う条件・避ける条件・単位・境界条件・制約と一次文献を個別に整理。文献・コードの確認であり、新しい数値検証を意味しません。
scope.en: Method-specific problems, adopted variants, use/avoid conditions, units, boundaries, limitations and primary sources for 24 priority methods. Source/code inspection is separate from new numerical validation.

review_kind: method conditions, primary sources and existing code inspected; no new numerical runs

name.ja: 風上差分（upwind）

summary.ja: 流れの上流側の値を用い、1次元の一定速度輸送を1次精度で進める基準法。公開例は周期格子の前進Euler更新で、風向きとCFL条件、数値拡散の関係を比較できる。
summary.en: A first-order baseline for one-dimensional constant-speed transport using the upstream value. The released periodic forward-Euler example exposes flow direction, the CFL restriction and numerical diffusion.

methods.code_mapping_scope: Scoped fixed-input examples; original method variants and earlier releases remain distinct.

references.label: Courant, Isaacson & Rees (1952). On the solution of nonlinear hyperbolic differential equations by finite differences.
references.scope: Historical upstream-differencing lineage. Only bibliographic metadata were checked; the scalar update and CFL statement here come from the atlas code.

supports.ja: 風上差分に関係する歴史的な一次文献。今回は書誌を確認し、本サイトのスカラー更新式との対応や安定条件はコードから記述する。
supports.en: Historical primary source associated with upstream differencing. The local scalar specialization and stability condition are established from code inspection.

verification.locator: Publisher title, authors, year, volume and pages; full text unavailable.

assumptions: The problem is q_t+a q_x=0 with constant real a on a uniform grid.
The fully discrete difference_step uses forward Euler and switches between backward and forward differences according to the sign of C=a Δt/Δx.
For this linear periodic update, use |C|≤1 for stability and monotonicity. finite_difference alone is a spatial operator and does not specify a time integrator.
methods.units: q may have any consistent unit; x is length, t is time, and a is length/time. C=a Δt/Δx is dimensionless. Released periodic benchmarks are nondimensional.
methods.boundary_conditions: Periodic boundaries are imposed with np.roll. Inflow, outflow and wall boundaries require a separate ghost-state implementation.

limitations.ja: 空間・時間とも1次精度で、一般に波形や接触面を拡散させる。|C|>1ではこの陽的更新の安定性は保たれない。一定速度のスカラー例だけから、変係数・非線形系や多次元での保存性・安定性は保証しない。
limitations.en: First order in both space and time and generally diffusive for waves and contacts. The explicit periodic update is unstable for |C|>1. This constant-speed scalar example establishes no conservation or stability guarantee for variable-coefficient, nonlinear-system or multidimensional extensions.

metadata_review.level: method-specific source-and-code inspection; no numerical rerun; reference access recorded individually

assumptions_ja: 対象はq_t+a q_x=0、一定の実速度a、一様格子である。
公開の完全離散更新difference_stepは前進Eulerで、C=a Δt/Δxの符号に応じて後退差分と前進差分を切り替える。
この線形周期更新の安定性・単調性には|C|≤1を用いる。finite_difference単独は空間演算子であり時間積分法を指定しない。
methods.units_ja: qの単位は任意だが一貫させる。xは長さ、tは時間、aは長さ/時間で、C=a Δt/Δxは無次元。公開の周期ベンチマークは無次元化されている。
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: np.rollによる周期境界。流入・流出や壁境界を扱うにはゴースト値の実装が別途必要で、現在の周期演算子をそのまま転用しない。

problem.ja: 一定速度で運ばれるスカラー分布の時間発展。
problem.en: Time evolution of a scalar distribution transported at constant speed.

variant.ja: advection.pyの符号対応1次風上差分。difference_stepは前進Euler、finite_differenceは周期空間微分を提供する。
variant.en: Sign-aware first-order upstream differencing in advection.py: forward Euler in difference_step and a periodic spatial derivative in finite_difference.

ja: 一定速度の周期移流で、安定性と数値拡散を分けて学ぶ。
高次法の比較用に簡単で単調な基準更新が必要で、|C|≤1を満たせる。
en: Study stability and numerical diffusion for constant-speed periodic advection.
Use a simple monotone baseline for comparison with higher-order methods when |C|≤1 can be enforced.

ja: 小さな拡散で細部を長時間保つ必要がある。
変速度の保存則や非周期境界を追加処理なしで解きたい。
en: Long-time preservation of fine features with little numerical diffusion is essential.
Variable-speed conservation laws or nonperiodic boundaries are required without additional treatment.

title.ja: Zalesak型2D回転輸送：保存・有界性・形状誤差
title.en: Zalesak-type 2D rotation: conservation, bounds and shape error

summary.ja: スロット付き円盤を実際の2次元有限体積法で一回転させ、donor-cellとminmod MUSCLを比較します。3格子と、半セルの中心ずらし・45度の初期向きを含む8計算で、保存・各SSP段の有界性・形状誤差とスロットの埋まりを測ります。
summary.en: Rotate a slotted disk through one full turn with an actual 2D finite-volume solver, comparing donor-cell and minmod MUSCL. Eight runs combine three grids with half-cell-center and 45-degree-start probes; measure conservation, bounds at every SSP stage, shape error and slot filling.

assumptions.ja: 無次元の[0,1]²、回転中心(.5,.5)、円盤中心(.5,.75)、半径.15、スロット幅.05・上端y=.85、角速度1、一回転T=2π、64²/128²/256²セルを固定します。スロット以外はq=1、外側は0です。周期境界を使い、厳密な物体の支持は境界から離れます。速度の周期延長には接線成分の継ぎ目があり、数値拡散の裾が届く場合は境界帯の質量として記録します。
assumptions.en: Fix the dimensionless unit square, rotation center(.5,.5), disk center(.5,.75), radius.15, slot width.05/top y=.85, angular speed1, T=2pi and64²/128²/256² cells. The body is1 and exterior/slot0. Periodic normal face velocities match; the exact compact support stays away from the boundary. The periodic extension has a tangential-velocity seam, and diffusive tails reaching its fixed-width boundary band are measured.

algorithm.ja: 解析的な発散ゼロの法線面速度と、隣接セルで共有する上流数値流束を用います。区分定数donor-cellと、方向別minmod勾配による平均保存型MUSCLを、どちらもSSPRK(3,3)で進めます。4面中点の平均がセル平均に等しいことと、各面のCourant数≤1/4による凸結合を使い、実際の値.20を各FE段で確認します。セル平均のクリップ、状態floor、刻み棄却・再試行は行いません。
algorithm.en: Use analytic divergence-free normal face averages and one shared upwind flux per interface. Both piecewise-constant donor-cell and mean-preserving directional-minmod MUSCL use SSPRK(3,3). The four face-midpoint mean equals the cell mean; individual outgoing-face Courant<=1/4 gives a convex FE update. Check the actual .20 bound at every stage. No transported-state clipping/floors or rejected/retried steps are used.

validation.ja: 26単体検査と8固定計算158判定を実行前に固定します。全FE候補・SSP凸結合のmin/max、共有流束による質量収支、再構築の平均保存、3格子のL1/L∞・相対L2を保存します。円と凸多角形の交差面積から独立に作る厳密輸送のセル平均を、SciPyの鉛直切片求積と面積・一次モーメントで照合します。1/4・1/2・3/4回転の誤差と重心も検査し、回転方向や速度の誤りが一回転のreturnだけで隠れないようにします。
validation.en: Freeze26 unit checks and158 gates across eight fixed runs before execution. Retain min/max of every FE candidate/SSP convex mean, shared-flux mass budgets, reconstruction mean preservation and three-grid L1/Linf/relative-L2 errors. Independent circle/convex-polygon intersection means are qualified against SciPy vertical-slice quadrature, total area and first moments. Also check quarter/half/three-quarter-turn errors and centroids so a wrong direction or speed cannot hide behind a full-turn return.

limits.ja: 標準的なスロット形状を単独の0–1物体として使う周期境界の限定例です。Zalesak原著のFCTアルゴリズム、原著の格子・境界、bell/coneを加えたFiredrakeデモ全体の再現ではありません。スロット内の診断は、固定した内側長方形と区分定数セル平均との面積重み付き値です。粗格子では厳密セル平均の投影だけでも0にならないため、その参照baselineと過剰な埋まりを別々に示します。格子中心・45度方向の2診断を普遍的な等方性保証とせず、完全な形状保持や一般流れの最大値原理を主張しません。解析幾何の微小な面積丸め処理と、実際の輸送状態をクリップしないことを区別します。
limits.en: This is an isolated0–1 standard slotted body with periodic boundaries. It does not implement Zalesak FCT, reproduce the original paper’s grid/boundaries or the entire Firedrake bell/cone/background demonstration. The inner-slot diagnostic area-weights piecewise-constant means over a fixed rectangle. Coarse exact cell projection can already give a nonzero baseline, which is reported separately from excess numerical filling. Two center/orientation probes do not establish universal isotropy, perfect shape retention or a maximum principle for arbitrary flows. Tiny geometric-area roundoff handling is distinguished from the absence of transported-state clipping.

formulas: q^{(1)}=E_{\Delta t}(q^n),\quad q^{(2)}=\tfrac34q^n+\tfrac14E_{\Delta t}(q^{(1)}),\quad q^{n+1}=\tfrac13q^n+\tfrac23E_{\Delta t}(q^{(2)})
\frac{\Delta t}{h}\max(|u|,|v|)\le\tfrac14,\quad D_h\!\cdot u=0\quad\Longrightarrow\quad 0\le E_{\Delta t}(\bar q)\le1\ \text{if all four face states lie in }[0,1]

reference_qualification.scope: Independent analytic geometry qualification, not a PDE solver. True first moments are distinct from cell-center centroid quadrature. No Firedrake software was executed.

depth_scope.ja: 追加のZalesak型例は与えた発散ゼロ速度による2次元スカラー回転輸送です。同一の周期格子・SSPRK(3,3)で一次風上とminmod MUSCLを比較し、各段の範囲・保存量と一回転後の形状誤差を調べます。FCT法や多次元Euler全般の有界性を認証しません。 追加は非一様な移動セルの1Dスカラー輸送で、正の物理速度−面速度を用いる実際の相対上流流束です。Euler流体やremap法ではありません。
depth_scope.en: The additional Zalesak-type example is two-dimensional scalar rotation in a prescribed divergence-free velocity. Compare donor-cell upwinding and minmod MUSCL with the same periodic grid and SSPRK(3,3), measuring stage bounds, conservation and full-turn shape errors. It does not certify FCT or general multidimensional Euler bounds. Additional1D scalar transport on nonuniform moving cells uses actual upwind flux with positive physical-minus-face speed; not Euler fluid or remapping.

title.ja: 非一様移動格子で実際に運ぶALEスカラー
title.en: ALE scalar transport on genuinely nonuniform moving cells

summary.ja: 質量と格子面位置を同じHeun段で更新し、一様GCLだけでなく非一様な解析波を運びます。

summary.ja: 保存則の各界面を局所Riemann問題として扱う有限体積の基準法。公開例は区分一定の空間再構成に近似流束とSSPRK3を組み合わせ、Sod問題で高次法との差を比較する。
summary.en: A finite-volume baseline using a local Riemann problem at each interface. The released example combines piecewise-constant spatial reconstruction, an approximate flux and SSPRK3, enabling comparison with higher-order solvers on Sod's problem.

methods.code_mapping_scope: Scoped fixed-input examples; original method variants and earlier releases remain distinct.

verification.locator: Publisher abstract and bibliographic record; full text not reviewed.

supports.ja: Sod衝撃波管という比較課題の出典。参照値は本サイトの非真空・理想気体Riemann解評価器で求め、論文表を転記した値とは区別する。

verification.locator: Publisher-indexed abstract and bibliographic record; detailed initial-state tables not reviewed.

assumptions: The scope is one-dimensional hyperbolic conservation laws on a uniform Cartesian grid with a model-compatible numerical flux.
Euler assumes a perfect gas and positive density/pressure; HLLC and other Euler fluxes are available. Shallow-water and isothermal models require HLL or Rusanov in this solver.
solve(...,method='godunov') sets reconstruction slopes to zero and advances with SSPRK(3,3). Initial data are sampled at grid locations and used as cell values.
The released solver requires 0<CFL≤0.5; this bound alone is not a positivity guarantee for arbitrary inputs.
methods.units: Use units consistent with each model's conserved variables and fluxes. Euler uses density ρ, momentum density ρu and total energy density E; each flux has its conserved-variable unit times length/time. Released shock tubes are nondimensional.
methods.boundary_conditions: The released _pad supplies periodic ghosts, fixed initial endpoint states, or edge extrapolation. Extrapolation is not an exact nonreflecting condition; reflecting walls and general inflow conditions are not implemented. Boundary fluxes contribute to global balances on nonperiodic domains.

limitations.ja: 空間1次なので衝撃波や接触面が広がる。原報の厳密Riemann解を用いる1段更新そのものではなく、時間3次でも全体の空間精度は1次のまま。近似流束・初期値の点サンプル・境界処理の選択に依存し、真空、乾湿境界、一般EOS、多次元および一般的な正値性・エントロピー保証は対象外。
limitations.en: First-order spatial reconstruction smears shocks and contacts. This is not the original one-step exact-Riemann algorithm, and third-order time stepping does not raise its spatial order. Results depend on the approximate flux, sampled initialization and boundary treatment. Vacuum, wet/dry fronts, general equations of state, multiple dimensions, and general positivity/entropy guarantees are outside scope.

metadata_review.level: method-specific source-and-code inspection; no numerical rerun; reference access recorded individually

assumptions_ja: 対象は1次元・一様Cartesian格子上の双曲型保存則で、各方程式に整合する流束を選ぶ。
Eulerでは理想気体、正の密度・圧力を前提とし、HLLC等を選べる。浅水・等温モデルにはHLLまたはRusanovを選ぶ。
公開solve(...,method='godunov')は傾きを0にし、SSPRK(3,3)で時間積分する。初期値は格子点でのサンプルをセル値として与える。
公開solverが受け付けるCFLは0<CFL≤0.5。この上限だけで任意の入力の正値性を保証するものではない。
methods.units_ja: 方程式ごとの保存変数と流束に一貫した単位を使う。Eulerでは密度ρ、運動量密度ρu、全エネルギー密度Eで、流束の単位は各保存量×長さ/時間。公開衝撃波管は無次元。
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: 公開_padは周期、端点初期値固定、または端値の外挿でゴースト値を作る。外挿は厳密な無反射条件ではなく、反射壁や一般の流入条件は実装していない。非周期領域の総量変化には境界流束が入る。

variant.ja: solvers.solveのmethod='godunov': 区分一定状態＋選択した近似Riemann流束＋SSPRK(3,3)。既定Euler流束はHLLC。
variant.en: method='godunov' in solvers.solve: piecewise-constant states, a selected approximate Riemann flux and SSPRK(3,3). HLLC is the default Euler flux.

Vacuum, dry states or complex boundaries require guarantees absent from this baseline solver.

title.ja: SWASHES地形流：静水と非零流量の定常解

summary.ja: 水没・露出した隆起上の静水と、非零流量の亜臨界定常解を別々に検査します。静水の保存と、動く定常流に残る離散化誤差を区別します。
summary.en: Check two lake equilibria separately from nonzero subcritical flow, distinguishing lake preservation from moving-flow discretization error.

assumptions.ja: 1次元、g=9.81、長さ25m、8<x<12でz=.2−.05(x−10)²m。水位.5/.1mの静水は200セル、流量4.42m²/s・下流深さ2mの定常流は100/200/400セル、t=2s。地形は区分定数セル平均。定常流から開始し、静水からの定常化実験とは区別します。
assumptions.en: 1D, g=9.81, L=25m, compact parabolic bed z=.2-.05(x-10)^2 on8<x<12. Lakes at surface .5/.1m use200 cells. Moving flow q=4.42m2/s, downstream h=2m uses100/200/400 cells to2s. Initialize the steady branch, not the published rest-to-steady transient.

algorithm.ja: 非負な静水圧再構成、共有HLL流束と左右の圧力補正で地形源項を離散化します。前進Euler、面Courant数.4。静水は反射壁。亜臨界流は上流で流量・下流で水深のみを指定し他変数を外挿します。floor・clip・retryはありません。 HLL更新を非負の水量packetに代数的に分解し、丸め後の同じ水量から移流運動量を作ります。微小水深閾値や事後修復は使いません。
algorithm.en: Hydrostatic reconstruction, shared HLL flux and left/right pressure corrections discretize the bed source; forward Euler and face CFL .4. Lakes use reflecting walls. Moving subcritical boundaries impose upstream q and downstream h, extrapolating the other datum. No state floors, clipping or retries. Algebraically factor HLL updates into nonnegative water packets; advected momentum uses those same rounded masses, without a small-depth threshold or subsequent repair.

validation.ja: 31単体検査と8固定計算を事前固定。静水の水深・流量の最大変化、全FE段の非負水深、共有流束と地形運動量の収支、定常流3格子の保存量セル平均L1誤差・細分化比を保存します。独立したBernoulli二分法のエネルギー一定・亜臨界枝を照合します。
validation.en: Freeze31 unit checks and eight group runs. Record lake drift, every FE minimum depth, shared-flux/bed-impulse budgets, conservative-mean L1 errors and three-grid ratios. Qualify an independent Bernoulli bisection by energy and branch checks.

limits.ja: 静水の厳密釣合いは表現したセル地形に対する性質です。非零流量の定常解は厳密には保存されず、有限時刻の誤差を測ります。遷移流・跳水・摩擦・降雨・浸透・2次元流や完全離散エントロピー安定性は検証しません。
limits.en: Exact lake balance concerns the represented cell bed. Moving steady states retain finite-time numerical error. Transcritical flows, jumps, friction, rain, infiltration, 2D flow and fully discrete entropy stability are outside scope.

title.ja: 乾いた河床のダム破壊：実際のwetting/drying
title.en: Dry-bed dam break: actual wetting and dry states

summary.ja: 右半分を厳密にh=q=0として開始する浅水方程式を解き、実際の乾湿前線の進行と保存をRitter解析解と比較します。
summary.en: Start the right half at exactly h=q=0 and compare wetting-front advance, conservation and conservative errors with the Ritter analytic solution.

assumptions.ja: 平坦床・無摩擦、[−10,10]m、ダムx=0、左深さ1m・右0m、初速0、g=9.81、t=.5s、1600/3200/6400セル。SWASHESのRitter式を明示した別スケールで使い、原例の.005m・6s入力とは区別します。
assumptions.en: Flat frictionless bed on[-10,10]m, dam0, hL=1m/hR=0, initial velocity0, g=9.81, t=.5s,1600/3200/6400 cells. The Ritter formula uses an explicit rescaling distinct from the paper numerical example.

algorithm.ja: 同じ有限体積ソルバーが乾状態h=q=0を直接扱います。片側乾床HLL波速はu−c,u+2c（反対向きも同様）。面Courant数.4で前進Euler更新し、状態の切上げなしに全更新後の非負性と共有流束収支を記録します。 HLL更新を非負の水量packetに代数的に分解し、丸め後の同じ水量から移流運動量を作ります。微小水深閾値や事後修復は使いません。
algorithm.en: The FV solver supports h=q=0 directly; one-sided dry HLL speeds use u-c/u+2c and their reflection. Forward Euler at face CFL .4 records every minimum and shared-flux budget without raising cell depths. Algebraically factor HLL updates into nonnegative water packets; advected momentum uses those same rounded masses, without a small-depth threshold or subsequent repair.

validation.ja: 全段の水深min、新たに濡れた初期乾セル数、残る乾セル数、境界流束を含む質量・運動量収支を保存します。Ritterのhとhuをファン端で分割したGauss8セル平均と比較し、Gauss16・全質量・PDE残差で参照を確認。3格子L1細分化とh≥.001mの最右セル中心を検査します。 水深L1の合否は初回と同じ固定参照質量5m²で正規化し、領域を広げたことによる基準の緩和を防ぎます。領域全体の相対L1は別の診断です。
validation.en: Record all FE minima, newly wetted and remaining dry cells, boundary-aware mass/momentum budgets, and L1 refinement. Split Gauss8 h/hu references are qualified by Gauss16, mass and PDE identities. Diagnose the rightmost cell center with mean h>=.001m. Depth acceptance uses the original fixed5m2 reference mass, preventing domain extension from weakening the criterion; full-domain relativeL1 remains a separate diagnostic.

limits.ja: 前線診断はセル平均の.001m等深線で、厳密な支持端を別に保存します。非負性は固定実行の実測です。初期乾セルの濡れを検査し、後退汀線・周期的な再乾燥、実地洪水、摩擦や地形上の移動前線は検証しません。 初回100/200/400セル・[−5,5]mでは28検査と105/109判定が合格し、乾セル残存3判定と前線誤差.3960>.25mが不合格でした。元の全記録を保持し、許容条件を変えず領域・格子を細分化しました。 領域・格子だけを変えた第2回は微小な裾のbinary64 underflowで停止しました。第3回は同じHLL更新の水量packetによる代数的評価を導入し、元の28検査に3検査を追加します。 第3回は108/109判定が合格し、最細の前線誤差.27415>.25mで不合格でした。第4回は同じ領域のRitter格子だけを1600/3200/6400に細分化します。相対水深L1は領域内参照質量で正規化し、領域変更を比べるため絶対L1も保存します。
limits.en: The .001m mean-depth contour differs from the analytic support edge, which is reported separately. These fixed runs test wetting of initially dry cells. Retreating shorelines, re-drying cycles, real floods, friction and moving fronts over topography are outside scope. The initial100/200/400-cell [-5,5]m attempt passed28 tests and105/109 gates; three retained-dry-cell gates and the .3960m>.25m contour error failed. All original records remain archived; revision2 enlarges/refines the input without changing acceptance. Revision2 then stopped on a binary64 subnormal-tail dry-momentum artifact. Revision3 factors the same HLL update into water packets and adds three regression/equivalence tests; the original28 remain unchanged. Revision3 passed108/109 gates but failed the .27415m>.25m contour criterion. Revision4 refines only Ritter grids to1600/3200/6400. Relative depth L1 is normalized by domain reference mass; absolute L1 is also retained because the domain changed between revisions1 and2.

summary.en: An approximate Riemann flux that restores the contact wave missing from HLL, improving Euler contact resolution. The released implementation is one-dimensional and perfect-gas, with Davis-type outer acoustic speeds.

assumptions: Left/right states are perfect-gas Euler variables (ρ,ρu,E), finite with ρ>0 and p>0, using a physical γ>1.
Outer speeds are S_L=min(u_L−c_L,u_R−c_R) and S_R=max(u_L+c_L,u_R+c_R); the contact speed and two star states are computed algebraically.
HLLC supplies an interface flux. Reconstruction, time integration, CFL control and boundary states are provided by the caller.
The local HLLC branch accepts Euler only; availability of HLL for another model does not make this HLLC implementation applicable to it.
methods.units: Use one consistent unit system on both sides. ρ is density, u, c and wave speeds are length/time, and p and E are energy/volume. Numerical fluxes have conserved-variable units times length/time. γ is dimensionless; released examples are nondimensional.
methods.boundary_conditions: Physical boundary conditions do not belong to the interface-flux function. The caller constructs left/right states; the existing one-dimensional solver uses periodic, fixed-initial-endpoint or extrapolated-edge states.

limitations.ja: 接触波の復元は一般的な正値性・エントロピー安定性の保証ではない。このDavis型波速版を、強い希薄波・真空や一般EOS、MHD、相対論的流体に追加処理なしで用いない。静止接触の一致テストも、移動衝撃波や全問題での厳密性を意味しない。
limitations.en: Contact restoration is not a general positivity or entropy-stability guarantee. This Davis-speed version should not be extended without additional treatment to strong rarefactions, vacuum, general equations of state, MHD or relativistic flow. Exact agreement for a stationary contact does not imply an exact solution for moving shocks or arbitrary problems.

HLLCは界面流束であり、再構成、時間積分、CFLと境界状態は呼び出し側が与える。
本実装のHLLC分岐はEuler専用であり、HLLを使える他のモデルにも自動適用できるわけではない。
methods.units_ja: 左右で同じ単位系を使う。ρは密度、uとcと各波速は長さ/時間、pとEはエネルギー/体積。数値流束は保存量×長さ/時間の単位を持つ。γは無次元で、公開例も無次元。

summary.en: A WENO method targeting fifth-order spatial accuracy in smooth regions while adapting stencil weights near discontinuities. The released Euler example is pointwise finite-difference WENO-Z with global Lax–Friedrichs flux splitting and SSPRK3.

assumptions: The scope is one-dimensional perfect-gas Euler on a uniform Cartesian grid, with finite positive density and pressure at each stage.
q contains point values, not cell averages. A global a=max|u±c| splits f±=(f±a q)/2; oppositely biased five-point stencils reconstruct the two fluxes.
Weights use d=(0.1,0.6,0.3), Jiang–Shu β_k, τ_5=|β_0−β_2| and α_k=d_k[1+(τ_5/(ε+β_k))²], with default ε=10^-6.
Both split fluxes use the same face-frozen Roe characteristic basis by default; component reconstruction is optional. Time integration is SSPRK(3,3), with 0<CFL≤0.5.
methods.units: Released Euler examples are nondimensional. With dimensional data, β and τ scale as the squared projected flux, so the effect of a fixed ε=10^-6 changes with scaling. Nondimensionalize states/fluxes or choose a scale-consistent ε. Use compatible units for Δt, Δx and wave speed.
methods.boundary_conditions: reconstruction._pad uses periodic ghosts, fixed initial endpoint states or edge extrapolation. Uniform high-order boundary accuracy and nonreflection are not guaranteed.

limitations.ja: 5次は滑らかな領域での空間精度であり、時間は3次。不連続近傍で同じ次数は期待できず、ε・尺度・基底の影響を受ける。段階で非正値になると時間刻みを半減して再試行するが、これは正値性の定理ではない。WENO分岐はHLLCを使わず、有限体積PPM/MUSCL用の正値再構成スケーリングも使わない。
limitations.en: Fifth order refers to smooth-region spatial accuracy; time accuracy is third order. The same order is not expected near discontinuities, and ε, scaling and basis matter. Invalid stages trigger step halving and retries, which do not constitute a positivity theorem. The WENO branch uses neither HLLC nor the positive-reconstruction scaling used by the finite-volume PPM/MUSCL branch.

assumptions_ja: 対象は1次元・一様Cartesian格子の理想気体Eulerで、各段階に有限かつ正の密度・圧力を要する。

title.ja: WENO-JS／Z：臨界点とεの固定比較

summary.ja: 同じセル平均からのWENO5再構成と実際の周期輸送で、JS重みとZ二乗重みを比較します。3種類の臨界性、3種類のε、固定格子と時間刻み半減を分けて保存します。
summary.en: Compare WENO5 JS and Z power-two weights from the same cell means, then evolve actual periodic transport. Retain three regularity classes, three epsilon choices, fixed grids and separate halved-time-step diagnostics.

assumptions.ja: 局所多項式のセル中心x=0、再構成面h/2、h=1/64…1/512を使います。輸送は[0,1]周期・速度1・q₀=cos(2πx)+.1sin³(2πx)、T=1、32/64/128セルです。全て有限体積セル平均であり、点値を誤差の参照にしません。
assumptions.en: Local polynomials have center x=0 and target h/2, h=1/64…1/512. Transport uses periodic[0,1], unit speed, q₀=cos(2πx)+.1sin³(2πx), T=1 and32/64/128 cells. All evolved states/references are FV cell means, not point samples.

algorithm.ja: 3候補と線形重み(.1,.6,.3)、Jiang–Shu指標を共通にし、JSはd/(β+ε)²、Zはd[1+(|β₀−β₂|/(β+ε))²]を正規化します。ε=10⁻⁴⁰,10⁻⁶,h²です。輸送は共有風上面流束と古典RK4、Courant.1を使い、状態クリップ・再試行を行いません。
algorithm.en: Share three candidates, linear weights(.1,.6,.3) and JS indicators. Normalize JS d/(beta+epsilon)² or Z d[1+(|beta0−beta2|/(beta+epsilon))²]. Use epsilon10⁻⁴⁰,10⁻⁶,h². Actual transport uses shared upwind face fluxes and classical RK4 at Courant.1 without state clipping/retries.

validation.ja: 実行前契約で72局所再構成・24PDE計算・36pytestを固定します。解析セル平均を独立Gauss12求積と照合し、局所の誤差・重み、輸送のL1/L2/L∞・質量・全段有限性・中間時刻と保存流束を記録します。最細格子で6通りの刻み半減差が対応する連続解誤差の10%以下か確認します。
validation.en: Pre-run contract fixes72 local reconstructions,24 PDE runs and36 pytest checks. Qualify analytic means against independent Gauss12 quadrature; retain local errors/weights, transport L1/L2/Linf, mass, stage finiteness, intermediate times and shared-flux budgets. Six finest-grid half-dt differences must be at most10% of corresponding continuum errors.

limits.ja: 一次臨界点の面再構成だけに次数判定を置き、二次臨界点は診断値として残します。固定εは解の振幅・単位に依存します。局所再構成の次数とPDE全体の次数、有限体積版と原著の有限差分版を区別します。衝撃波、Euler/MHD、一般の高次臨界点、任意入力の安定性・TVD・正値性は今回の保証に含めません。
limits.en: Order gates concern the chosen first-critical interface reconstruction; second-critical values remain diagnostic. Fixed epsilon depends on amplitude/units. Distinguish reconstruction order from PDE convergence and this FV implementation from original FD papers. No shock/Euler/MHD, arbitrary higher-critical-point, universal stability/TVD or positivity guarantee is claimed.

formulas: (p_0,p_1,p_2)=\frac16(2\bar q_{i-2}-7\bar q_{i-1}+11\bar q_i,-\bar q_{i-1}+5\bar q_i+2\bar q_{i+1},2\bar q_i+5\bar q_{i+1}-\bar q_{i+2})

name.ja: 古典的RK4

summary.ja: 滑らかな非硬い常微分方程式を4回の右辺評価で4次精度に進める古典Runge–Kutta法。公開例では次数条件、安定関数、非線形・時刻依存問題を比較し、SSP性やシンプレクティック性とは区別する。
summary.en: Classical four-stage Runge–Kutta advances smooth nonstiff ODEs with fourth-order accuracy. Released examples compare order conditions, stability functions and nonlinear/time-dependent problems while distinguishing accuracy from SSP and symplectic properties.

methods.code_mapping_scope: Scoped fixed-input examples; original method variants and earlier releases remain distinct.

references.label: Butcher (1963). Coefficients for the study of Runge-Kutta integration processes.
references.scope: Primary formulation of Runge–Kutta order conditions, including fourth-order conditions; not attributed as the historical invention of classical RK4.

supports.ja: Runge–Kutta法の次数条件を定式化した一次文献。4次条件を扱う本文を確認したが、古典RK4の発明論文という意味では引用しない。
supports.en: Primary order-condition formulation, with the fourth-order discussion inspected. This is not presented as the historical invention paper for classical RK4.

verification.locator: Runge–Kutta definitions and p. 196 fourth-order conditions; relevant portions read, not every proof.

assumptions: The target is the initial-value problem y'=f(t,y), with sufficient smoothness of f and y for fourth-order convergence.
The adopted classical tableau has c=(0,1/2,1/2,1), a21=1/2, a32=1/2, a43=1 and b=(1,2,2,1)/6.
The caller selects the step. A semidiscrete PDE also imposes spatial spectral/CFL restrictions; linear modes require |R(hλ)|≤1.
methods.units: h and t have the same time unit, and f_i has units y_i/time. State-component units belong to the problem; RK4 imposes no intrinsic physical unit. hλ is dimensionless.
methods.boundary_conditions: Spatial boundary conditions do not apply to the ODE step itself. For a PDE, each stage's RHS evaluation must supply the appropriate boundary values or ghost states.

limitations.ja: 陽解法でA安定・L安定ではなく、硬い減衰では小さい刻みを要する。一般の非線形問題に正のSSP係数を持たず、正値性・TVD性・エネルギー保存・シンプレクティック性を4次精度から導くことはできない。このrk_stepは固定刻みの部品で、埋込み誤差推定や自動刻み調整を持たない。
limitations.en: Explicit RK4 is neither A-stable nor L-stable and may require small steps for stiff decay. It has no positive general nonlinear SSP coefficient; fourth-order accuracy implies neither positivity, TVD, energy conservation nor symplecticity. The released rk_step is a fixed-step component without an embedded error estimator or adaptive controller.

metadata_review.level: method-specific source-and-code inspection; no numerical rerun; reference access recorded individually

assumptions_ja: 対象は初期値問題y'=f(t,y)で、4次収束を期待する区間では右辺と解に十分な滑らかさがある。
時間刻みは呼び出し側が選び、空間離散したPDEではそのスペクトル・CFL制約にも従う。線形モードでは|R(hλ)|≤1を確認する。
methods.units_ja: 時間hとtは同じ単位、f_iはy_i/時間の単位。状態成分の単位は問題が定め、RK4自体は固有の物理単位を持たない。hλは無次元。
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: 時間ステップ単体に空間境界条件は該当しない。PDEを進める場合、境界値やゴースト状態は各段階の右辺評価が正しく供給する必要がある。

en: Very stiff decay or general DAEs must be handled.
SSP/positivity guarantees or long-time Hamiltonian structure preservation are essential.

title.ja: 反応拡散：空間2次と時間4次を分けて測る
title.en: Reaction-diffusion: separate second-order space and fourth-order time

summary.ja: 線形の拡散・反応演算子を、連続と半離散のFourier厳密解を用いて小規模に検証します。
summary.en: Validate a small linear diffusion-reaction operator against continuous and semidiscrete Fourier solutions.

assumptions.ja: 周期区間[0,2pi)、D=0.1、r=0.1、初期cos(2x)、終了t=2。格子16/32/64と、別の固定格子で刻み0.5/0.25/0.125を用います。
assumptions.en: Periodic[0,2pi), D=0.1,r=0.1, initial cos(2x), final t=2. Use grids 16/32/64 and a separate fixed-grid timestep sequence 0.5/0.25/0.125.

algorithm.ja: 周期中心2階差分と独自RK4で進めます。空間系列は小さな同一時間刻み、時間系列は同じ空間演算子を用います。
algorithm.en: Advance original periodic second-centered differences with RK4. The spatial sequence uses one small time step; the temporal sequence fixes the spatial operator.

validation.ja: 連続固有値r-Dk²への最大誤差で空間次数、半離散固有値r-4Dsin²(kdx/2)/dx²への最大誤差で時間次数を測ります。独立した解析参照であり同じ実装の細格子値を参照にしません。
validation.en: Measure spatial order against r-Dk² and temporal order against r-4Dsin²(kdx/2)/dx². Both are independent analytic references, rather than a finer-grid run of the same solver.

limits.ja: 線形・周期・滑らかな単一モードだけを検証します。非線形のFisher前線、複雑境界、空間生態系や一般の反応ネットワークの検証ではありません。
limits.en: Only a linear, periodic, smooth single mode is verified. Nonlinear Fisher fronts, complex boundaries, spatial ecosystems and general reaction networks remain outside scope.

title.ja: Turing不安定性：線形成長率と小振幅パターン
title.en: Turing instability: linear growth and small-amplitude patterns

summary.ja: Schnakenberg型反応拡散で、一様平衡の安定性と拡散による選択モードの成長を行列指数で検証します。
summary.en: Use a matrix exponential to validate stable homogeneous kinetics and diffusion-driven growth of a selected Schnakenberg mode.

assumptions.ja: 無次元a=0.1,b=0.9、平衡(1,0.9)、拡散係数(0.01,1)、周期k=2、初期振幅1e-4。線形t=1と非線形t=4の短い計算に限定します。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless a=0.1,b=0.9, equilibrium(1,0.9), diffusivities(0.01,1), periodic k=2 and initial amplitude1e-4. Restrict runs to linear t=1 and nonlinear t=4.

algorithm.ja: 独自の中心差分・RK4で線形化PDEと短い非線形PDEを進めます。3格子でのモード振幅と成長率、非線形の濃度最小値・初期パターン増幅を記録します。
algorithm.en: Advance the linearized and short nonlinear PDEs using original centered differences/RK4. Record mode amplitudes/growth on three grids, minimum concentrations and early-pattern amplification.

validation.ja: 連続Fourier行列J-k²DのSciPy expmと線形数値解を比較し空間収束を測定。非線形計算は半離散線形行列指数との小振幅差を測り、成熟模様の参照照合とは区別します。
validation.en: Compare linear numerical fields with SciPy expm of continuum J-k²D and measure spatial convergence. Quantify the nonlinear run against a semidiscrete linear matrix exponential as a small-amplitude check, not validation of mature morphology.

limits.ja: 1つの平衡近傍の発生段階です。原著係数や原著実験の再現、成熟模様、ランダム擾乱からの波数選択、実生物の較正は主張しません。
limits.en: One near-equilibrium onset experiment. No claim reproduces original-paper parameters/experiments, mature patterns, wavenumber selection from random noise or biological calibration.

title.ja: FitzHugh–Nagumo：パルス興奮・回復と独立ODE参照
title.en: FitzHugh-Nagumo: pulse excitation, recovery and an independent ODE reference

summary.ja: 2変数の膜興奮縮約ODEを電流パルスで励起し、DOP853との全出力時刻の誤差・時間収束・回復を確認します。
summary.en: Excite a two-variable reduced membrane ODE with a current pulse; check all-output-time errors, temporal refinement and recovery against DOP853.

assumptions.ja: 無次元a=0.7,b=0.8,tau=12.5。I=0の休止平衡からt=10〜20だけI=0.8を与え、t=80まで進めます。生理学的な物理単位への較正はしません。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless a=0.7,b=0.8,tau=12.5. Start at resting equilibrium for I=0, apply I=0.8 only during t=10..20 and integrate to t=80. No calibration to physiological physical units.

algorithm.ja: 独自RK4を刻み0.1/0.05/0.025で使用し、パルスの不連続点で時間区間を厳密に分割します。出力刻み0.1でピークと休止状態からの距離も測定します。
algorithm.en: Use original RK4 with steps 0.1/0.05/0.025, splitting time intervals exactly at pulse discontinuities. At output spacing 0.1, measure the peak and distance from rest.

validation.ja: 別実装SciPy DOP853のrtol1e-11と1e-13を比較して参照の感度を確認し、厳しい参照への最大解誤差と時間次数を評価します。ピーク時刻は出力格子上の精度です。
validation.en: Compare separate SciPy DOP853 at rtol=1e-11 and 1e-13 to check reference sensitivity; measure maximum solution error and time order against the tighter reference. Peak time is resolved only on the output grid.

limits.ja: FHN/BVP型の縮約ODEの限定検証です。HH全イオンチャネル、空間軸索、患者データ、実測電気生理の再現を含みません。
limits.en: Scoped verification of an FHN/BVP-style reduced ODE. It excludes full HH ion channels, spatial axons, patient data and experimental electrophysiology reproduction.

review.en: Official DOP853, dense output, tolerance and success specifications checked. Implementation documentation for the separate numerical reference.

depth_scope.ja: 反応拡散：空間2次と時間4次を分けて測る: 線形の拡散・反応演算子を、連続と半離散のFourier厳密解を用いて小規模に検証します。 Turing不安定性：線形成長率と小振幅パターン: Schnakenberg型反応拡散で、一様平衡の安定性と拡散による選択モードの成長を行列指数で検証します。 FitzHugh–Nagumo：パルス興奮・回復と独立ODE参照: 2変数の膜興奮縮約ODEを電流パルスで励起し、DOP853との全出力時刻の誤差・時間収束・回復を確認します。 セル平均からのWENO-JS／Z二乗重みの臨界点再構成と、実際の周期スカラー輸送を比較します。εの違い、解析セル平均と点値、空間誤差と時間刻みの影響を分けます。 追加は実際の2D C-grid線形回転浅水場をRK4で時間発展。同じ離散作用素の行列指数を参照にし、連続波の空間誤差と固定N時間細分化を区別します。
depth_scope.en: Reaction-diffusion: separate second-order space and fourth-order time: Validate a small linear diffusion-reaction operator against continuous and semidiscrete Fourier solutions. Turing instability: linear growth and small-amplitude patterns: Use a matrix exponential to validate stable homogeneous kinetics and diffusion-driven growth of a selected Schnakenberg mode. FitzHugh-Nagumo: pulse excitation, recovery and an independent ODE reference: Excite a two-variable reduced membrane ODE with a current pulse; check all-output-time errors, temporal refinement and recovery against DOP853. Compare critical-point reconstruction from cell means using WENO-JS/Z power-two weights and actual periodic scalar transport. Separate epsilon choices, analytic cell means versus point values, and spatial error versus time-step effects. Additional actual2D C-grid linear rotating-SWE fields use RK4. A matrix exponential of the same semidiscrete operator is reference-only; separate continuous spatial and fixed-N temporal errors.

title.ja: WENO-JS／Z：臨界点とεの固定比較
title.en: WENO-JS/Z: fixed critical-point and epsilon comparison

summary.ja: 同じセル平均からのWENO5再構成と実際の周期輸送で、JS重みとZ二乗重みを比較します。3種類の臨界性、3種類のε、固定格子と時間刻み半減を分けて保存します。
summary.en: Compare WENO5 JS and Z power-two weights from the same cell means, then evolve actual periodic transport. Retain three regularity classes, three epsilon choices, fixed grids and separate halved-time-step diagnostics.

assumptions.ja: 局所多項式のセル中心x=0、再構成面h/2、h=1/64…1/512を使います。輸送は[0,1]周期・速度1・q₀=cos(2πx)+.1sin³(2πx)、T=1、32/64/128セルです。全て有限体積セル平均であり、点値を誤差の参照にしません。
assumptions.en: Local polynomials have center x=0 and target h/2, h=1/64…1/512. Transport uses periodic[0,1], unit speed, q₀=cos(2πx)+.1sin³(2πx), T=1 and32/64/128 cells. All evolved states/references are FV cell means, not point samples.

algorithm.ja: 3候補と線形重み(.1,.6,.3)、Jiang–Shu指標を共通にし、JSはd/(β+ε)²、Zはd[1+(|β₀−β₂|/(β+ε))²]を正規化します。ε=10⁻⁴⁰,10⁻⁶,h²です。輸送は共有風上面流束と古典RK4、Courant.1を使い、状態クリップ・再試行を行いません。
algorithm.en: Share three candidates, linear weights(.1,.6,.3) and JS indicators. Normalize JS d/(beta+epsilon)² or Z d[1+(|beta0−beta2|/(beta+epsilon))²]. Use epsilon10⁻⁴⁰,10⁻⁶,h². Actual transport uses shared upwind face fluxes and classical RK4 at Courant.1 without state clipping/retries.

validation.ja: 実行前契約で72局所再構成・24PDE計算・36pytestを固定します。解析セル平均を独立Gauss12求積と照合し、局所の誤差・重み、輸送のL1/L2/L∞・質量・全段有限性・中間時刻と保存流束を記録します。最細格子で6通りの刻み半減差が対応する連続解誤差の10%以下か確認します。
validation.en: Pre-run contract fixes72 local reconstructions,24 PDE runs and36 pytest checks. Qualify analytic means against independent Gauss12 quadrature; retain local errors/weights, transport L1/L2/Linf, mass, stage finiteness, intermediate times and shared-flux budgets. Six finest-grid half-dt differences must be at most10% of corresponding continuum errors.

limits.ja: 一次臨界点の面再構成だけに次数判定を置き、二次臨界点は診断値として残します。固定εは解の振幅・単位に依存します。局所再構成の次数とPDE全体の次数、有限体積版と原著の有限差分版を区別します。衝撃波、Euler/MHD、一般の高次臨界点、任意入力の安定性・TVD・正値性は今回の保証に含めません。
limits.en: Order gates concern the chosen first-critical interface reconstruction; second-critical values remain diagnostic. Fixed epsilon depends on amplitude/units. Distinguish reconstruction order from PDE convergence and this FV implementation from original FD papers. No shock/Euler/MHD, arbitrary higher-critical-point, universal stability/TVD or positivity guarantee is claimed.

formulas: (p_0,p_1,p_2)=\frac16(2\bar q_{i-2}-7\bar q_{i-1}+11\bar q_i,-\bar q_{i-1}+5\bar q_i+2\bar q_{i+1},2\bar q_i+5\bar q_{i+1}-\bar q_{i+2})

name.ja: L安定なSDIRK2

summary.ja: 硬い常微分方程式の減衰を扱う2段2次の陰的Runge–Kutta法。公開版はγ=1−1/√2のstiffly accurateなL安定SDIRKで、各段階にNewton法を用い、別のラッパーでステップ倍化による局所誤差制御を行う。
summary.en: A two-stage second-order implicit Runge–Kutta method for stiff ODE decay. The release uses stiffly accurate L-stable SDIRK with γ=1−1/√2 and Newton stage solves; a separate wrapper adds step-doubling local-error control.

methods.code_mapping_scope: Related chapter modules and test files; not a claim that each test covers every named method.

references.label: Alexander (1977). Diagonally Implicit Runge–Kutta Methods for Stiff O.D.E.’s.
references.scope: Primary source for the two-stage second-order stiffly stable DIRK family; the selected gamma and stability function are established from the local tableau and official supplementary documentation.

supports.ja: 2段2次の硬い系向けDIRK法の一次文献。採用γと安定関数は本サイトの係数および公式補足資料から特定し、原報全文確認とは区別する。
supports.en: Primary paper for two-stage second-order stiff DIRK formulae. The selected coefficient is separately identified from the code and official documentation.

verification.locator: Publisher abstract and metadata; full-text tableau not reviewed.

references.label: MOOSE. LStableDirk2.
references.scope: Official implementation documentation relating the two-stage second-order L-stable DIRK method to Alexander (1977); supplementary to the primary paper, not a replacement for it.

supports.ja: Alexander法との関係と2段2次・L安定性を明記する公式実装資料。数式画像は今回のテキスト取得では読めておらず、係数はローカル実装を根拠にする。
supports.en: Official documentation identifies the two-stage second-order L-stable method and its Alexander reference. Equation images were not readable in the text extraction; local coefficients are the implementation evidence.

verification.locator: LStableDirk2 description, Notes and References; equation images were not extracted by the text browser.

assumptions: The target is an ODE y'=f(t,y) represented by a real one-dimensional array, with a consistent Jacobian ∂f/∂y supplied by the caller.
A=[[γ,0],[1−γ,γ]], b=(1−γ,γ), c=(γ,1), and γ=1−1/√2. This stiffly accurate form returns the last stage.
With exact stage solves, R(z)=[1+(1−2γ)z]/(1−γz)^2. This γ gives A-stability and R→0 as |z|→∞ in the left half-plane.

Newton convergence is required at each stage. Distinguish fixed-step integrate from adaptive_sdirk2, which estimates error from (two half steps−one full step)/3 and accepts the two-half-step solution.
methods.units: h has time units, f_i has y_i/time, and J_ij has y_i/(y_j×time). Nondimensionalization or component scaling is needed: the fixed Newton tolerance 2×10^-12 does not automatically adapt to arbitrary physical units. Adaptive atol sets state scales and rtol is dimensionless.
methods.boundary_conditions: Spatial boundaries do not apply to the ODE time step itself. For semidiscrete PDEs, incorporate boundary conditions and their time dependence consistently into the RHS and Jacobian.

limitations.ja: L安定性は正確な段階解を前提とする線形試験方程式の性質であり、大刻みの精度・非線形収束・正値性を保証しない。Newton失敗時は固定版が例外、適応版が試行棄却を行う。埋込み対ではなくステップ倍化で、rtol/atolは局所誤差尺度であり最終大域誤差の保証ではない。一般DAE、質量行列、イベント処理は未実装。
limitations.en: L-stability concerns the linear test equation with accurate stage solves; it guarantees neither large-step accuracy, nonlinear convergence nor positivity. A Newton failure raises in the fixed version and rejects a trial in the adaptive wrapper. Adaptivity uses step doubling, not an embedded pair; rtol/atol control a local error scale, not a guaranteed final global error. General DAEs, mass matrices and events are not implemented.

metadata_review.level: method-specific source-and-code inspection; no numerical rerun; reference access recorded individually

assumptions_ja: 対象は実数の1次元配列で表すODE y'=f(t,y)。整合するJacobian ∂f/∂yを呼び出し側が与える。
A=[[γ,0],[1−γ,γ]]、b=(1−γ,γ)、c=(γ,1)、γ=1−1/√2。最終段を次の解にするstiffly accurate版。
正確な段階解に対する安定関数はR(z)=[1+(1−2γ)z]/(1−γz)^2。このγではA安定かつ左半平面で|z|→∞のときR→0となる。
実装では各段階のNewton収束が必要。固定刻みintegrateと、(2半歩−1全歩)/3を使って2半歩の解を採用するadaptive_sdirk2を区別する。
methods.units_ja: hは時間、f_iはy_i/時間、Jacobian要素J_ijはy_i/(y_j×時間)。無次元化または成分尺度の調整が必要で、固定のNewton許容値2×10^-12は任意の物理単位に自動対応しない。適応版のatolは状態尺度、rtolは無次元。
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: ODE時間積分単体には空間境界条件は該当しない。PDEの半離散系に使う場合、境界条件とその時刻依存性を右辺とJacobianへ整合して組み込む。

problem.ja: 速い減衰モードと遅い変化が共存する常微分方程式の初期値問題。
problem.en: ODE initial-value problems with rapidly decaying modes and slower evolution.

variant.ja: stiff.pyのsdirk2_step: γ=1−1/√2の2段2次stiffly accurate SDIRK。Newtonは許容値2×10^-12・最大25回。適応ラッパーは独立のステップ倍化。
variant.en: sdirk2_step in stiff.py: two-stage second-order stiffly accurate SDIRK with γ=1−1/√2. Newton uses tolerance 2×10^-12 and at most 25 iterations. The separate adaptive wrapper uses step doubling.

ja: 硬い減衰を抑えつつ2次精度で進め、右辺とJacobianを用意できる。
陰的段階の収束と、許容誤差を変えた結果の比較を管理できる。

summary.en: Existing releases: A second-order reversible symplectic method using half kick, drift and half kick for position-dependent forces. Released unit-mass harmonic/quartic oscillators illustrate why energy error and geometric structure preservation are different properties. Additional fixed examples: Unsoftened Kepler two-body time error, Short-time32body dynamics from a cold Plummer-density sample. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. Additional fixed examples: Warm PIC linear Landau damping, Warm PIC two-stream initial growth. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. Additional fixed examples: Independently coded PIC spatial pipeline. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

assumptions: The released example is an autonomous separable one-degree-of-freedom Hamiltonian H(q,p)=p²/2+V(q) with unit mass and V=q²/2 or q²/2+q⁴/4.
The force is −V'(q), depending only on position. The update is p_half=p−h V'(q)/2, q_new=q+h p_half, p_new=p_half−h V'(q_new)/2.
Reversibility and symplecticity refer to the same fixed-step map. Dynamical time scales must still be resolved for accuracy and stability.
methods.units: The released oscillator is nondimensional with m=1 and harmonic ω=1. A general-mass formulation would require drift h p/m and consistent position, momentum, force and time scales; that generalization is not an input feature of this released function.
methods.boundary_conditions: Spatial boundary conditions do not apply to this oscillator phase-space map. It is a different problem from the original periodic Lennard-Jones fluid; particle periodicity, walls and constraints are not implemented here.

limitations.ja: 既存配布版の制約：元のHamiltonianを各ステップで厳密保存するわけではない。シンプレクティックでも大刻みは不安定になり得て、ω=1の調和振動子では|h|<2が安定域の内部。速度依存力、摩擦・サーモスタット、拘束、一般の可変刻みや非分離Hamiltonianでは、同じ性質をそのまま保証できない。公開関数は一般分子動力学solverではない。 今回の追加固定例：1周期・固定離心率のみ。軟化軌道や長時間安定性はこの参照の範囲外。 冷たい有限N初期値で平衡Plummer分布/連続球厳密軌道ではありません。BHの一般相反性・大域symplectic性は主張しません。 今回の追加固定例：1D1V・固定イオン・無衝突の小規模例です。正のGauss速度重みのfull-f粒子を全て動かします。4シードのSEとt区間は静かな空間シフトに条件付けられ、i.i.d.粒子雑音やN^(-1/2)収束の証明ではありません。速度積分の偏りは別の倍増計算で検査。線形参照は独立した連続モデルの導出で、独立非線形Vlasovエンジンではありません。二流の後期は診断表示で飽和値を合否に用いません。偶数格子のNyquist電荷を別記し、そのモードまでGauss則を満たすとは表示しません。 4シフトのStudent-t区間は名目上の条件付き要約で、真の率に対する被覆率や全誤差を検証したものではありません。 1D1V・固定イオン・無衝突の小規模例です。正のGauss速度重みのfull-f粒子を全て動かします。4シードのSEとt区間は静かな空間シフトに条件付けられ、i.i.d.粒子雑音やN^(-1/2)収束の証明ではありません。速度積分の偏りは別の倍増計算で検査。線形参照は独立した連続モデルの導出で、独立非線形Vlasovエンジンではありません。二流の後期は診断表示で飽和値を合否に用いません。偶数格子のNyquist電荷を別記し、そのモードまでGauss則を満たすとは表示しません。 4シフトのStudent-t区間は名目上の条件付き要約で、真の率に対する被覆率や全誤差を検証したものではありません。 今回の追加固定例：離散演算の独立したコーディング照合です。時間積分法や連続方程式を変えた独立エンジン、連続極限の収束、冷たいプラズマの振動参照の再現を意味しません。既存cold-plasma-picの関連補助検証として扱い、温かい初期速度の軌道を冷たい解と同一視しません。
limitations.en: Limits of existing releases: The original Hamiltonian is not exactly preserved at each step. A symplectic map can still be unstable at large steps; for the ω=1 harmonic oscillator, |h|<2 is the interior stability interval. Velocity-dependent forces, friction/thermostats, constraints, generic variable steps and nonseparable Hamiltonians require different treatment. This function is not a general molecular-dynamics solver. Additional fixed examples: One orbit at fixed eccentricity only; softened binaries and long-time behavior are outside this exact reference. Cold finite-N initial value,not an equilibrium Plummer DF or exact continuum orbit. No general BH reciprocity/global symplecticity claim. Additional fixed examples: Small fixed1D1V collisionless electrons with fixed ions. Every positive-weight Gauss-velocity full-f carrier moves. Seed SE/t intervals are conditional on quiet spatial shifts, not iid particle noise or N^(-1/2) convergence. Velocity-quadrature bias has a separate doubling probe. The independent reference is a derived linear continuum IVP, not a second nonlinear Vlasov engine. Late two-stream behavior is diagnostic; no saturation-value gate. Even-grid Nyquist charge is separately reported rather than included in a full-spectrum Gauss claim. Four-shift Student-t intervals are nominal conditional summaries; neither coverage of the exact rate nor total error is established. Small fixed1D1V collisionless electrons with fixed ions. Every positive-weight Gauss-velocity full-f carrier moves. Seed SE/t intervals are conditional on quiet spatial shifts, not iid particle noise or N^(-1/2) convergence. Velocity-quadrature bias has a separate doubling probe. The independent reference is a derived linear continuum IVP, not a second nonlinear Vlasov engine. Late two-stream behavior is diagnostic; no saturation-value gate. Even-grid Nyquist charge is separately reported rather than included in a full-spectrum Gauss claim. Four-shift Student-t intervals are nominal conditional summaries; neither coverage of the exact rate nor total error is established. Additional fixed examples: Independent coding check of discrete spatial operators. It does not change the time integrator/continuum model, establish continuum convergence, or reproduce the cold-plasma oscillation reference. A related supplement of cold-plasma-pic; the finite warm velocity spread is explicit.

title.ja: PIC空間演算の独立実装照合
title.en: Independently coded PIC spatial pipeline

summary.ja: ベクトル化CIC/FFTと、別に書いた粒子ループCIC・密なDFTを、それぞれが自己無撞着な場を毎kick計算する軌道全体で照合します。
summary.en: Compare vectorized CIC/FFT with separately authored scalar-particle CIC/dense DFT; each trajectory sources its own field at every kick.

assumptions.ja: 周期[0,2π]、256粒子、格子8/16/32、シード35001/35002、dt=.02、T=.24。位置は一様乱数、v=.2 Normal+.1 sin x。6組は別々に進めた12軌道です。
assumptions.en: Periodic[0,2pi],256particles,grids8/16/32,seeds35001/35002,dt.02,T.24. Uniform random positions,v=.2Normal+.1sin(x). Six pairs mean twelve separately evolved trajectories.

algorithm.ja: 独立側はPythonスカラー配置、明示的な複素DFT和、独自の補間ループを所有します。主側のFFT・配置・補間を呼びません。数学上のCIC、Nyquist規約、velocity-Verlet法、初期配列は共通です。
algorithm.en: The independent path owns scalar deposition, explicit complex DFT sums and scalar gathering; it imports no primary spatial routines. Mathematical CIC, Nyquist convention, velocity-Verlet and initial arrays are intentionally shared.

validation.ja: 19 pytestと58/58固定判定が合格。6組＝12の自己無撞着軌道を13時刻全てで照合し、最大差は位置8.88e−16・速度3.33e−16・電場8.33e−16・電荷2.89e−15。pytest+mainは0.392秒。最初の小pytestは周期端点の添字不具合で17/18となり、元記録を保持して修正後に全計算を実行しました。
validation.en: 19pytest and58/58fixed gates passed. Compare six pairs=twelve self-consistent trajectories at all13states; maximum differences:x8.88e-16,v3.33e-16,E8.33e-16,rho2.89e-15. Shared pytest+main.392s. Initial small pytest retained17/18with a periodic-index failure; integer wrapping was corrected before the first fixed main batch.

limits.ja: 離散演算の独立したコーディング照合です。時間積分法や連続方程式を変えた独立エンジン、連続極限の収束、冷たいプラズマの振動参照の再現を意味しません。既存cold-plasma-picの関連補助検証として扱い、温かい初期速度の軌道を冷たい解と同一視しません。
limits.en: Independent coding check of discrete spatial operators. It does not change the time integrator/continuum model, establish continuum convergence, or reproduce the cold-plasma oscillation reference. A related supplement of cold-plasma-pic; the finite warm velocity spread is explicit.

note.en: Small fixed1D1V collisionless electrons with fixed ions. Every positive-weight Gauss-velocity full-f carrier moves. Seed SE/t intervals are conditional on quiet spatial shifts, not iid particle noise or N^(-1/2) convergence. Velocity-quadrature bias has a separate doubling probe. The independent reference is a derived linear continuum IVP, not a second nonlinear Vlasov engine. Late two-stream behavior is diagnostic; no saturation-value gate. Even-grid Nyquist charge is separately reported rather than included in a full-spectrum Gauss claim. Four-shift Student-t intervals are nominal conditional summaries; neither coverage of the exact rate nor total error is established.

name.ja: 共役勾配法

summary.ja: 既存配布版：実対称正定値な連立一次方程式を共役方向で反復的に解く。公開例は単位正方形・零Dirichlet Poisson方程式の五点差分を、行列を組み立てずに扱う前処理なしCG。 追加固定例：係数ジャンプ拡散：共有流束とMG・AMG、回転異方性拡散：完全テンソルQ1とMG・AMG。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Existing releases: Solve real SPD linear systems by conjugate directions. The public example is unpreconditioned matrix-free CG for the five-point zero-Dirichlet Poisson operator on a unit square. Additional fixed examples: Checkerboard diffusion: shared flux, MG and AMG, Rotated diffusion: full-tensor Q1, MG and AMG. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

methods.code_mapping_scope: Scoped fixed-input examples; original method variants and earlier releases remain distinct.

references.label: Hestenes, M. R. & Stiefel, E. (1952). Methods of Conjugate Gradients for Solving Linear Systems.
references.scope: Real SPD conjugate-gradient recurrence; not the heat time integrator used elsewhere in the chapter.

supports.ja: 実対称正定値系に対するCGの反復式と、丸め誤差がある場合の有限回終了の限界。
supports.en: CG recurrence for real SPD systems and the qualification of finite termination in floating-point arithmetic.

verification.locator: Sections 2–3, especially (3:1) and the discussion of rounding error, pp. 410–411.

assumptions: The operator must be real SPD and the right-hand side finite; the example discretizes constant-coefficient −Δu=f on a uniform square grid.
Inner products are Euclidean array products; the current implementation starts from zero and has no preconditioner.
poisson_comparison.solve stops on a recomputed true relative residual; linear.poisson_2d uses a recurrence residual with tolerance×max(1,initial residual).
methods.units: CG has no intrinsic physical unit. The public Poisson coordinates have unit dimensionless length; dimensionally [f]=[u]/[length]². Residual norms are unweighted array norms.
methods.boundary_conditions: CG itself supplies no physical boundary condition. The public 2D Poisson examples impose u=0 on every side of [0,1]² by zero padding.

limitations.ja: 既存配布版の制約：非対称・不定・特異な系にそのまま適用しない。前処理、一般疎行列入力、純Neumannの零空間処理はこのCG例にはない。小さい残差は離散化誤差の保証ではなく、単一固有モードの速い終了を一般的性能と解釈しない。 今回の追加固定例：係数比100の固定例。P1格子差は厳密誤差上界ではなく、特異交点の次数や普遍的なMG/AMG優劣は主張しません。 指定した角度・異方性の限定例。スカラーTPFAを回転テンソルへ転用せず、一般テンソルへの頑健性は保証しません。
limitations.en: Limits of existing releases: Do not apply this variant directly to nonsymmetric, indefinite or singular systems. This CG example has no preconditioner, general sparse-matrix interface or pure-Neumann nullspace handling. A small residual does not certify discretization accuracy; rapid termination for one eigenmode is not a general performance result. Additional fixed examples: Fixed contrast100 example. P1 differences are not rigorous error bounds; no singular exponent or universal MG/AMG winner is asserted. One angle/anisotropy only. Scalar TPFA is not extended to rotated tensors; arbitrary-tensor robustness is not established.

metadata_review.level: method-specific sources and implementation inspected; no new numerical rerun

supplemental_review.level: Frozen fixed-input source,independent review,actual pytest/main and independently extracted ZIP; see each new release for exact reference independence and failed-attempt history.

assumptions_ja: 作用素は実対称正定値で、右辺は有限。ここでは定係数の −Δu=f を一様正方格子で離散化する。
内積は配列成分のEuclidean内積。既存実装の初期値は零で、前処理は用いない。
poisson_comparison.solve は再計算した真の相対残差を停止に使う。linear.poisson_2d は反復残差と tolerance×max(1,初期残差) を使う。
methods.units_ja: CG自体に固有の物理単位はない。公開Poisson例は長さ1の無次元座標で、次元を与えるなら [f]=[u]/[長さ]²。残差は格子体積で重み付けしない配列ノルム。
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: 代数解法としてのCGは境界を定めない。公開2次元Poisson例は [0,1]² の全辺で u=0 をゼロ埋め込みにより課す。

name.ja: Armijo減衰Newton法

summary.ja: 非線形方程式 F(x)=0 を、Jacobianから求めたNewton方向と残差ノルムの十分減少による減衰で解く。公開例は密行列解法または前処理付きGMRESの内部解法を選べる。
summary.en: Solve F(x)=0 using a Jacobian-based Newton direction and damping that requires sufficient decrease of the residual norm. The example supports a dense or preconditioned GMRES inner solve.

methods.code_mapping_scope: Related chapter modules and test files; not a claim that each test covers every named method.

references.label: Armijo, L. (1966). Minimization of functions having Lipschitz continuous first partial derivatives.
references.scope: Source for sufficient-decrease and halving-backtracking ideas; the atlas adapts the test to ||F||, not to the paper's steepest-descent problem.

supports.ja: 十分減少と刻みの半減という考え方の根拠。原論文の最小化の収束定理を、この非線形方程式実装の保証とはしない。
supports.en: Supports sufficient decrease and step halving; the minimization theorem is not a convergence certificate for this root solver.

verification.locator: Printed pp. 1–3; convergence theorem and Corollary 2, equation (2).

references.label: Dembo, R. S., Eisenstat, S. C. & Steihaug, T. (1982). Inexact Newton Methods.
references.scope: Newton equations and approximate inner linear solves; context for the GMRES path, not proof of the atlas's particular forcing rule.

supports.ja: Newton方程式を近似的に解く定式化。今回確認したのは抄録であり、実装固有の内部許容誤差の定理適合は未確認。
supports.en: Formulates approximate Newton solves; only the abstract was reviewed, not a theorem audit of the implemented inner tolerance.

verification.locator: Publisher abstract and bibliographic metadata, as returned by web search; direct full text not reviewed.

assumptions: The caller supplies F and its Jacobian; the basic setting is a square differentiable system with a nonsingular Jacobian near the root.
Starting at one, the step is halved until ||F(x+αs)||₂ ≤ (1−10⁻⁴α)||F(x)||₂; failure is returned below α=2⁻²⁰.
The GMRES path still uses an explicitly supplied Jacobian; CSR uses ILU(0), otherwise Jacobi preconditioning. Inner and outer absolute residual criteria differ.
methods.units: No intrinsic physical unit; the caller defines unknown and residual scales. Components are not nondimensionalized automatically, so scale them consistently before using the norm and absolute tolerance.
methods.boundary_conditions: Newton has no intrinsic physical boundary. F/Jacobian assembly supplies it; the existing Bratu test encodes zero Dirichlet values at both ends of [0,1].

limitations.ja: 初期値、Jacobianの非特異性、残差の尺度に依存し、大域的収束は保証しない。特異な密行列解法や前処理構築は例外となることがあり、すべてが失敗理由の戻り値に変換されるわけではない。行列なしJv、信頼領域、継続法は備えない。
limitations.en: Convergence depends on the initial guess, Jacobian nonsingularity and residual scaling; global convergence is not guaranteed. Singular dense solves or preconditioner construction may raise exceptions rather than return a failure reason. No matrix-free Jv, trust region or continuation is provided.

metadata_review.level: method-specific sources and implementation inspected; no new numerical rerun

assumptions_ja: FとJacobianを利用者が与える。平方の微分可能な系と、解の近くで非特異なJacobianが基本となる。
長さ1から1/2ずつ減らし、||F(x+αs)||₂ ≤ (1−10⁻⁴α)||F(x)||₂ を要求する。α<2⁻²⁰で失敗を返す。
GMRES経路でもJacobianは明示的に与える。CSRならILU(0)、それ以外ならJacobi前処理を使い、内部残差と外部絶対残差を区別する。
methods.units_ja: 固有の物理単位はなく、未知数・残差の尺度は呼び出し側が決める。単位・桁の違う残差成分を自動で無次元化しないため、ノルムと絶対許容誤差を使う前に尺度を揃える。
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: Newton法自体に物理境界はない。境界はFとJacobianの組立て側が指定する。既存Bratu検査は [0,1] の両端零Dirichletを内部未知数の残差へ組み込む。

summary.ja: 既存配布版：細格子で平滑化し、粗格子で滑らかな誤差を補正する幾何学的多重格子法。公開実装は単位正方形の零Dirichlet Poisson問題に対する固定階層のV-cycle。 追加固定例：係数ジャンプ拡散：共有流束とMG・AMG、回転異方性拡散：完全テンソルQ1とMG・AMG。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Existing releases: Geometric multigrid combines fine-grid smoothing with coarse-grid correction of smooth error. The public implementation is a fixed-hierarchy V-cycle for zero-Dirichlet Poisson on the unit square. Additional fixed examples: Checkerboard diffusion: shared flux, MG and AMG, Rotated diffusion: full-tensor Q1, MG and AMG. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

methods.code_mapping_scope: Scoped fixed-input examples; original method variants and earlier releases remain distinct.

references.label: Brandt, A. (1977). Multi-Level Adaptive Solutions to Boundary-Value Problems.
references.scope: Multilevel interaction for boundary-value solvers; the atlas implements only a fixed nested-grid geometric V-cycle.

supports.ja: 粗密の格子間で情報を交換する多重格子法の一次研究。論文中の適応格子機能を実装済みとはしない。
supports.en: Primary multilevel boundary-value research; its adaptive capabilities are not claimed for the fixed-grid atlas example.

verification.locator: Abstract on printed p. 333 available in indexed primary-paper text; full PDF fetched but no readable body extracted. Author bibliography separately checked.

assumptions: Constant-coefficient −Δu=f on a uniform square interior grid with n=2^k−1 per axis.
Coarse operators are rediscretized five-point operators; restriction is full weighting, prolongation bilinear, with three red-black Gauss–Seidel pre/post sweeps by default.
The one-unknown coarsest problem is solved exactly. Entry points use either mixed absolute/relative residual stopping or the comparison's true relative residual.
methods.units: The public problem uses dimensionless [0,1]² and h=1/(n+1). Dimensionally [f]=[u]/[length]²; residual norms have no mesh weights.
methods.boundary_conditions: u=0 on all sides of [0,1]². Error corrections also have homogeneous Dirichlet boundaries, implemented by zero padding.

limitations.ja: 既存配布版の制約：固定された正方形・定係数・入れ子格子の教育例。AMG、不規則格子、適応細分化、強い異方性や不連続係数用の特別な平滑化は実装しない。Brandt論文の全機能や任意問題での最適計算量を示すものではない。 今回の追加固定例：係数比100の固定例。P1格子差は厳密誤差上界ではなく、特異交点の次数や普遍的なMG/AMG優劣は主張しません。 指定した角度・異方性の限定例。スカラーTPFAを回転テンソルへ転用せず、一般テンソルへの頑健性は保証しません。
limitations.en: Limits of existing releases: An educational fixed-square, constant-coefficient nested-grid example. It does not implement AMG, irregular meshes, adaptive refinement or specialized smoothing for strong anisotropy/discontinuous coefficients. It does not establish all capabilities of Brandt's paper or optimal work for arbitrary problems. Additional fixed examples: Fixed contrast100 example. P1 differences are not rigorous error bounds; no singular exponent or universal MG/AMG winner is asserted. One angle/anisotropy only. Scalar TPFA is not extended to rotated tensors; arbitrary-tensor robustness is not established.

metadata_review.level: method-specific sources and implementation inspected; no new numerical rerun

supplemental_review.level: Frozen fixed-input source,independent review,actual pytest/main and independently extracted ZIP; see each new release for exact reference independence and failed-attempt history.

assumptions_ja: 定係数の −Δu=f、正方形の一様内部格子、各軸 n=2^k−1 の入れ子格子を仮定する。
粗格子作用素は五点差分の再離散化。full weighting制限、双線形補間、red-black Gauss–Seidelの前後各3回平滑化を標準とする。
最粗格子1未知数は厳密に解く。停止判定は公開入口により絶対値を併用した残差または共通比較用の真の相対残差。
methods.units_ja: 公開問題は無次元の [0,1]²、h=1/(n+1)。次元を与える場合 [f]=[u]/[長さ]²、残差ノルムは格子重みなし。
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: [0,1]² の全辺で u=0。誤差補正も零Dirichletで、ゼロ埋め込みにより境界値を入れる。

name.ja: 連続P1 Galerkin有限要素法

summary.ja: Poisson方程式の弱形式を、連続区分線形要素で離散化する。公開例は1次元区間と単位正方形の三角形分割で、剛性・整合質量行列を組み立て、非零Dirichlet値も消去できる。
summary.en: Discretize the weak Poisson problem with continuous piecewise-linear elements. The examples assemble stiffness/consistent-mass matrices on an interval and a triangulated unit square, including nonzero Dirichlet elimination.

methods.code_mapping_scope: Scoped fixed-input examples; original method variants and earlier releases remain distinct.

references.label: Courant, R. (1943). Variational methods for the solution of problems of equilibrium and vibrations.
references.scope: Piecewise-linear trial functions on triangular subdivisions in a variational formulation; not a source for the atlas's CSR or GMRES implementation.

supports.ja: 三角形分割上の区分線形関数による変分近似を根拠付ける。現代的な疎行列・線形解法の出典とは区別する。
supports.en: Supports triangular piecewise-linear variational approximation, separately from the modern sparse solver implementation.

verification.locator: Section III, paragraph on linear functions on triangles, PDF p. 15 (reprint printed p. 2179); primary-paper reprint.

assumptions: Approximate constant-coefficient −Δu=f by continuous P1 Galerkin elements: uniform intervals on [0,1] or affine triangles from diagonally split unit-square cells.
Element formulas assemble stiffness and consistent mass; forcing uses four-point Gauss quadrature in 1D and product Gauss quadrature under a Duffy transform on triangles.
Dirichlet rows/columns are symmetrically eliminated and the system is solved by ILU(0)-preconditioned GMRES; smooth manufactured solutions support L2/H1 error evaluation.
methods.units: Examples use dimensionless unit-length domains. With physical scaling, [f]=[u]/L²; stiffness and mass have geometric scales L^(d−2) and L^d in dimension d.
methods.boundary_conditions: Dirichlet data apply at both interval endpoints or the full unit-square perimeter; defaults are zero and callbacks allow nonzero data. This example does not assemble Neumann/Robin boundary integrals.

limitations.ja: 汎用メッシュ生成や曲線要素、可変係数、混合要素の実装ではない。L2で2次・H1半ノルムで1次という既存の検査は滑らかな製造解と本メッシュの範囲であり、角の特異性や任意領域へ無条件に一般化しない。
limitations.en: Not a general mesh generator or implementation of curved elements, variable coefficients or mixed elements. Existing second-order L2 and first-order H1-seminorm tests concern smooth manufactured solutions on these meshes; do not generalize them unconditionally to corner singularities or arbitrary domains.

metadata_review.level: method-specific sources and implementation inspected; no new numerical rerun

assumptions_ja: 定係数の −Δu=f を連続P1 Galerkin空間で近似する。1次元は [0,1] の一様区間、2次元は単位正方形を対角分割したアフィン三角形。
剛性・整合質量行列は要素公式を使う。右辺は1次元4点Gauss求積、三角形はDuffy変換の積Gauss求積で評価する。
Dirichletの行と列を対称に消去し、ILU(0)付きGMRESで解く。滑らかな製造解のL2/H1誤差評価を備える。
methods.units_ja: 公開例は無次元の長さ1の領域。物理尺度を付けるなら [f]=[u]/L²、次元dの剛性行列はL^(d−2)、質量行列はL^dの幾何学的尺度を持つ。
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: 区間の両端、または単位正方形の全外周にDirichlet値を指定する。標準値は零で、関数により非零値も指定できる。Neumann/Robin境界積分は本例では組み立てない。

summary.en: Solve a harmonic reentrant-corner field with actual2D P1 FEM; compare matched-DOF uniform/grading and separate smooth-square mesh distortion.

assumptions.ja: 第4象限を除いた[-1,1]²、theta∈[0,3pi/2]、u=r^(2/3)sin(2theta/3)、解析Dirichlet。N8/16/32、graded map x→x max(|x|,|y|)。正方形sin(pi x)sin(pi y)を同Nのregular/warpedで別検査。
assumptions.en: L-shaped[-1,1]² minus quadrantIV, theta0..3pi/2, analytic Dirichlet harmonic corner field. N8/16/32, fixed map x→x max(|x|,|y|). Separate unit-square sine MMS uses regular/warped grids.

algorithm.ja: 面積と物理勾配からP1剛性を組み、境界を消去して疎直接法で解きます。隅要素は原点をDuffy写像の頂点に移し、Gauss48/96を比較。
algorithm.en: Assemble physical P1 gradients/areas, eliminate boundary data and solve sparse systems. Corner triangles use origin-based Duffy quadrature48/96.

validation.ja: L2/H1積分誤差・求積差、一様/gradedの同DOF改善、別のsquare/warped系列、最小角・aspect・1ノルム条件数推定・真の線形残差を保存。
validation.en: Retain integrated L2/H1 errors, quadrature gaps, matched-DOF grading improvement, separate square/warp errors, minimum angle/aspect, estimated1-norm conditioning and true residuals.

limits.ja: 特異解に正方形のL2二次を要求しません。固定の事前graded写像でありAMRソフトではありません。条件数は推定で、任意歪みへの保証はしません。
limits.en: No smooth-square L2 order is imposed on the singular field. Fixed a-priori grading is not an AMR engine. Conditioning is estimated; arbitrary distortion is not certified.

assumptions: The reference interval is [−1,1] with weight one: ∫PⱼPₖdξ=2δⱼₖ/(2k+1); orthonormal=True multiplies by √((2k+1)/2).
Degree is a nonnegative integer. project_legendre approximates projection integrals by Gauss quadrature, leaving quadrature error for general functions.
Exact element-matrix quadrature means p+1 Gauss points for polynomial products with constant coefficients and an affine map.
methods.units: ξ and basis values are dimensionless. On an affine interval of length L, J=L/2 scales mass by J and gradient stiffness by 1/J. Expansion coefficients share the represented function's units.
methods.boundary_conditions: Basis evaluation/projection imposes no physical boundary condition. Endpoint values/fluxes and interelement coupling belong to the consuming discretization; the constant stiffness nullspace is not removed automatically.

limitations.ja: 中程度の次数向けの教育用表作成で、高次数での安定性・最適化を保証しない。不連続関数では単一多項式の収束と求積が制約される。Chebyshev基底の重みをLegendreの重み1と混同せず、GLL求積による最高モードの質量を厳密質量と同一視しない。
limitations.en: Educational tabulation for modest degrees, without high-degree stability/performance guarantees. Discontinuities limit single-polynomial approximation and quadrature. Do not confuse Chebyshev weights with the unit Legendre weight, or GLL quadrature's highest-mode mass with exact mass.

assumptions: Interval nodes must be distinct finite real values at modest degree; cardinal polynomials are evaluated through a Legendre Vandermonde solve.
For p≥1, GLL nodes are ±1 and roots of Pₚ′. A p+1-point GLL rule is exact through degree 2p−1, not generally for degree-2p mass products.
Triangle functions are only P1/P2 on (0,0),(1,0),(0,1). Quadrilaterals use Qₚ tensor products with (p+1)² degrees of freedom.
methods.units: Reference coordinates/basis values are dimensionless; nodal values carry the function's units. Affine interval matrices scale as M∝J and K∝1/J with J=L/2.
methods.boundary_conditions: GLL includes endpoints but does not itself enforce Dirichlet values or interelement continuity. The consuming discretization supplies values, fluxes and coupling.

limitations.ja: 高次数のVandermonde解法は条件数の制約を受け、安定なbarycentric表作成や汎用高次要素の代替ではない。等間隔節点の高次補間にはRunge現象がある。GLL集中質量と厳密質量のrank-1差は重み1・アフィン区間での結果で、三角形全般へ適用しない。
limitations.en: High-degree Vandermonde solves face conditioning limits and are not a replacement for stable barycentric tabulation or a general high-order element library. High-degree equispaced interpolation can exhibit Runge behavior. The rank-one exact/lumped GLL mass difference concerns the unweighted affine interval, not arbitrary triangles.

assumptions_ja: 区間節点は相異なる有限実数で、中程度の次数を想定する。区間のLagrange多項式はLegendre Vandermonde行列を解いて評価する。

三角形は (0,0),(1,0),(0,1) のP1またはP2のみ。四角形は区間基底のQₚ積で、自由度数は(p+1)²。
methods.units_ja: 参照座標と基底は無次元、節点値は表す関数の単位。アフィン区間行列はJ=L/2により M∝J、K∝1/J。

summary.ja: 既存配布版：孤立した3次元粒子の重力加速度をoctreeで近似する。公開例はG=1のPlummer軟化核に対し、質量単極子または同じ軟化核の完全な二次モーメント項を使い、直接和と比較する。 追加固定例：冷たいPlummer密度由来32粒子の短時間力学。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Existing releases: Approximate isolated 3D particle gravity with an octree. The public example uses G=1 and a Plummer-softened kernel, with a monopole or the same kernel's full second-moment term, compared with direct summation. Additional fixed examples: Short-time32body dynamics from a cold Plummer-density sample. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

methods.code_mapping_scope: Scoped fixed-input examples; original method variants and earlier releases remain distinct.

references.label: Barnes, J. & Hut, P. (1986). A hierarchical O(N log N) force-calculation algorithm.
references.scope: Octree hierarchical force evaluation; does not by itself document the atlas's full second-moment expansion of a Plummer-softened kernel.

supports.ja: 立方体を八分割する階層的な力計算の出典。今回確認した抄録から、軟化核や二次モーメント式の細部まで確認済みとはしない。
supports.en: Supports hierarchical octree force evaluation; the reviewed abstract does not establish the atlas's softened second-moment formula.

verification.locator: Publisher abstract and bibliographic metadata returned by web search; full article body not reviewed.

assumptions: Positions are finite (N,3), masses positive and finite, and N≥1; ε=softening>0, theta≥0 and order is 0 or 2.
A node is accepted when s/d<theta, with s=2×half and d measured to its center of mass. Target-containing cells are always opened; leaves exclude self terms.
The acceleration kernel is −m r/(r²+ε²)^(3/2). order=2 adds the full Taylor term from S=Σmδδᵀ, retaining trace(S) for the softened kernel.
methods.units: Dimensionless G=1. Positions and softening share a length unit and masses use one consistent unit. With scales L₀,M₀, acceleration is restored with GM₀/L₀².
methods.boundary_conditions: Isolated boundaries without periodic images; the softened potential −Gm/√(r²+ε²) tends to zero at infinity. This is a different boundary problem from periodic PM, Ewald or TreePM.

limitations.ja: 既存配布版の制約：静的な力の教育例で、時間積分・宇宙膨張・周期境界・FMMを含まない。thetaは厳密な誤差上限ではなく、order=2がすべての配置で常に改善する保証もない。対象ごとの近似なので厳密な作用反作用・全運動量保存は保証せず、相互作用回数は実時間や全分布でのO(N log N)の実測ではない。 今回の追加固定例：冷たい有限N初期値で平衡Plummer分布/連続球厳密軌道ではありません。BHの一般相反性・大域symplectic性は主張しません。
limitations.en: Limits of existing releases: A static-force educational example without time integration, expansion, periodic images or FMM. theta is not a rigorous error bound, and order=2 need not improve every configuration. Targetwise approximation does not guarantee exact action–reaction/total-momentum conservation. Interaction counts are not timings or empirical complexity guarantees for every distribution. Additional fixed examples: Cold finite-N initial value,not an equilibrium Plummer DF or exact continuum orbit. No general BH reciprocity/global symplecticity claim.

assumptions_ja: 位置は有限の(N,3)配列、質量は正かつ有限、粒子数は1以上。softening=ε>0、theta≥0、orderは0または2。

加速度核は −m r/(r²+ε²)^(3/2)。order=2はS=Σmδδᵀの完全なTaylor項を加え、軟化された核に必要なtrace(S)項も保持する。

summary.ja: 周期3次元粒子の質量をCICで格子へ割り当て、平均密度を除いたPoisson方程式をFFTで解き、格子加速度を同じCICで粒子へ戻す。公開例は連続Fourier記号 −4πG/k² とスペクトル微分を使う。
summary.en: Deposit periodic 3D particle mass by CIC, FFT-solve Poisson after removing mean density, and interpolate acceleration back with matched CIC. The example uses the continuum Fourier symbol −4πG/k² and spectral derivatives.

methods.code_mapping_scope: Related chapter modules and test files; not a claim that each test covers every named method.

references.label: Eastwood, J. W. & Hockney, R. W. (1974). Shaping the force law in two-dimensional particle-mesh models.

supports.ja: PMのCICを含む割当てと格子の力の誤差に直接関係する一次研究。2次元の論文であり、本実装の3次元Green関数を検証する文献とはしない。
supports.en: Directly supports PM assignment/CIC and mesh-force error context; this 2D paper is not a validation of the implemented 3D Green function.

verification.locator: Publisher abstract and metadata returned by web search; full text not reviewed.

assumptions: A cubic periodic box, positive finite particle masses, finite positions, cubic n³ mesh with n≥4 and L>0; coordinates wrap modulo L in every axis.
CIC deposits to eight vertices with product-linear weights divided by cell volume; interpolation uses the same weights. No CIC-window deconvolution is applied.
∇²φ=4πG(ρ−meanρ), with φ̂(0)=0. Nonzero modes use −4πG/k² and acceleration is −∇φ. On even meshes, each derivative zeroes its own-axis Nyquist mode to retain a real odd operator.
methods.units: pm_acceleration is a dimensionless G=1 example. L and positions share a length unit; density, potential and acceleration scale as M/L³, GM/L and GM/L². Only the lower-level periodic_poisson accepts a positive gravity parameter.
methods.boundary_conditions: Periodic in all directions with box length L. Mean removal enforces periodic-Poisson compatibility, while zeroing k=0 fixes the additive potential gauge. This is not the isolated-force problem.

limitations.ja: 格子以下の近接力を直接補正しないPMのみの静的例。CIC平滑化、格子異方性・aliasing・有限解像度があり、連続Fourier Green関数を有限差分Laplacianの離散逆作用素と混同しない。P3M・TreePM分割・Ewald・PME/SPME・宇宙膨張・時間積分は含まない。
limitations.en: A static PM-only example without direct short-range correction. CIC smoothing, grid anisotropy, aliasing and finite resolution remain; the continuum Fourier Green function is not the inverse symbol of a finite-difference Laplacian. No P3M, TreePM split, Ewald, PME/SPME, expansion or time integration is included.

metadata_review.level: method-specific sources and implementation inspected; no new numerical rerun

assumptions_ja: 立方体の周期箱、正かつ有限の粒子質量、有限位置、立方n³格子でn≥4、L>0を使う。位置は各軸でLを法として折り返す。
CICは8隅への積線形重みで密度を作り、格子体積で割る。粒子へ戻す補間も同じ重み。CIC窓の逆補正は行わない。
∇²φ=4πG(ρ−平均ρ)、φ̂(0)=0。非零モードは −4πG/k²、加速度は−∇φ。偶数格子の微分は各軸の対応Nyquistモードを零にして実の奇作用素を保つ。
methods.units_ja: pm_accelerationはG=1固定の無次元例。L・位置には同じ長さ単位を使い、ρは質量/L³、φはGM/L、加速度はGM/L²に対応する。下位関数periodic_poissonのみ正のgravityを指定できる。
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: 全方向周期、箱長L。平均密度を除くことで周期Poissonの整合性を満たし、k=0を零に固定してポテンシャルの加法定数を選ぶ。孤立境界の力とは同一問題でない。

assumptions: One electron in the Coulomb potential -Z/r of an isolated, infinite-mass point nucleus; nonrelativistic and field-free.
Separate angular momentum l and solve for the reduced radial orbital u(r), normalized by integral |u|^2 dr=1.
Released inputs use Z=1,2 and (n,l)=(1,0),(2,0),(2,1),(3,2); these cases do not cover arbitrary many-electron states.
A uniform interior radial grid and a real symmetric tridiagonal second-order kinetic operator are used.
methods.units: Atomic units (hbar=m_e=e=4 pi epsilon_0=1): r in bohr, energies/effective potentials in hartree, and normalized reduced orbitals u in bohr^(-1/2).
methods.boundary_conditions: u(0)=u(r_max)=0. Released hydrogenic refinement inputs use r_max=60 bohr; a separate Z=1 1s study uses r_max=4,8,16,32 bohr. Origin and infinity are approximated by regularity and finite-box Dirichlet conditions.

next_deliverable.ja: 既存の小規模例の固定入力・保存済み参照・配布物の整合を維持し、必要時に少数の代表ケースを再実行する。大規模な基底・k点走査、重い独立参照の再生成、長時間BOMD／CPMDは、必要性が指定された場合だけ別途検討する。
next_deliverable.en: Maintain fixed inputs, saved references and release integrity for the existing small examples; rerun a few representative cases when needed. Large basis/k-point sweeps, expensive independent-reference regeneration and long BOMD/CPMD trajectories are considered separately only on explicit need.

limitations.ja: 一般の多電子Schrödinger方程式の直接解法、時間発展、分子、周期系、相対論・核運動・スピン軌道相互作用は未実装。小さい離散固有値残差だけでは格子・領域誤差は除けず、有限差分の固有値は連続問題の変分上界とは限らない。
limitations.en: Not a general many-electron, time-dependent, molecular, periodic or relativistic solver; nuclear motion and spin–orbit effects are absent. Small discrete eigenpair residuals do not remove grid/domain error, and finite-difference eigenvalues are not guaranteed variational upper bounds to continuum energies.

metadata_review.level: method-specific primary-source and released-code inspection; saved 2026-11-21 results read; no new numerical run

assumptions_ja: 孤立・無限質量の点核によるCoulomb場−Z/r中の1電子。非相対論・外場なし。
角運動量lを分離し、∫|u|²dr=1で規格化した縮約動径軌道u(r)を解く。
公開入力はZ=1,2および(n,l)=(1,0),(2,0),(2,1),(3,2)。任意の多電子状態を検証したものではない。
一様な内部動径格子と、2次の運動エネルギー差分による実対称三重対角行列を用いる。
methods.units_ja: 原子単位系（ℏ=mₑ=e=4πε₀=1）。rはbohr、エネルギー・有効ポテンシャルはhartree、規格化した縮約軌道uはbohr⁻¹ᐟ²。
methods.boundary_conditions_ja: u(0)=u(r_max)=0。公開する水素型の格子検査はr_max=60 bohr。Z=1の1sは別途r_max=4,8,16,32 bohrを比較。原点の正則性と無限遠の減衰を有限箱のDirichlet条件で近似する。

caution.ja: 核運動、相対論、スピン軌道相互作用、外場はこの代表式に含めません。固有値の残差が小さくても、領域・基底の誤差は残ります。
caution.en: Nuclear dynamics, relativity, spin–orbit coupling and external fields are outside this representative Hamiltonian. A small eigenpair residual does not establish domain or basis convergence.

assumptions: Atomic branch: Nonrelativistic isolated He with Z=2, an infinite-mass point nucleus and two opposite-spin electrons occupying the same spherical 1s spatial orbital.
Atomic branch: Normalize integral |u|^2 dr=1 and define p=2|u|^2=4 pi r^2 n, so integral p dr=2.
Atomic branch: For this occupied orbital only, the Fock equation reduces to the effective field -2/r+v_H/2 and E_x=-E_H/2; no general nonlocal Fock operator is implemented.
Atomic branch: Single-determinant exchange is included; electron correlation is omitted.
Separate molecular branch: H2 RHF in finite s-Gaussian spaces, analytic one-/two-electron integrals and matrix SCF; see the H2 input and measured checks for its own tolerances.
methods.units: Atomic units (hbar=m_e=e=4 pi epsilon_0=1): r in bohr, energies/effective potentials in hartree, and normalized reduced orbitals u in bohr^(-1/2). Positive electron-number density n(r) is in bohr^(-3); radial number density p(r)=4 pi r^2 n(r) is in bohr^(-1), with integral p dr=N. p is not signed charge density. Molecular branch: normalized 3D AO functions in bohr^(-3/2); overlap, AO density matrix and electron count dimensionless; transformed Fock commutator in hartree. Molecular tolerances are stated separately.
methods.boundary_conditions: Helium reduced orbital: u(0)=u(r_max)=0, baseline r_max=16 bohr with a separate 4/8/12/16-bohr domain study. The Hartree field is finite at the origin and joins N/r outside the density; it is not fixed to zero at r_max. Separate H2 branch: isolated molecule, analytic whole-space Gaussian integrals; no finite radial box.

limitations.en: The local exchange reduction cannot be transferred unchanged to multi-orbital, open-shell, molecular or periodic systems. The atomic edition does not implement UHF/ROHF, molecular integrals or orbital-stability analysis. Saved PySCF RHF references are independent finite-Gaussian-basis calculations, not exact correlated helium energies. Separate grid, domain and SCF convergence from physical model error. H₂ uses a separate molecular-integral implementation. Molecular DFT, general multicenter molecules, open shells and orbital-stability analysis remain unimplemented.

assumptions: Atomic/molecular examples: Ground-state nonrelativistic isolated He with Z=2 and one doubly occupied spherical 1s Kohn–Sham orbital.
Atomic/molecular examples: p=2|u|^2=4 pi r^2 n and integral p dr=2, with n the total positive electron-number density of both spins.
Atomic/molecular examples: The adopted approximation is E_x[n]=-(3/4)(3/pi)^(1/3) integral n^(4/3) d^3r, v_x=-(3n/pi)^(1/3), and E_c=v_c=0.
Atomic/molecular examples: The effective field is -2/r+v_H+v_x; second-order radial differences and simple density mixing solve this restricted model.

Periodic KS-DFT for one fixed simple-cubic He cell. An educational PySCF workflow separately checks Gamma/k sampling, Gaussian orbital basis, auxiliary FFT grid and SCF tolerances against independent DFTK plane waves with identical GTH parameters and LDA exchange plus VWN5 correlation. Does not validate equilibrium helium solids, general materials or metals.
methods.units: Atomic/molecular examples: Atomic units (hbar=m_e=e=4 pi epsilon_0=1): r in bohr, energies/effective potentials in hartree, and normalized reduced orbitals u in bohr^(-1/2). Positive electron-number density n(r) is in bohr^(-3); radial number density p(r)=4 pi r^2 n(r) is in bohr^(-1), with integral p dr=N. p is not signed charge density. Periodic He: bohr, inverse bohr and hartree per neutral primitive cell; reciprocal-lattice fractional k coordinates.
methods.boundary_conditions: Atomic/molecular examples: Helium reduced orbital: u(0)=u(r_max)=0, baseline r_max=16 bohr with a separate 4/8/12/16-bohr domain study. The Hartree field is finite at the origin and joins N/r outside the density; it is not fixed to zero at r_max. Periodic He: three-dimensional Bloch boundaries in the fixed one-atom simple-cubic cell.

limitations.ja: 原子・分子の実行例の範囲：厳密汎関数の理論とDirac交換のみという近似を区別する。LDA相関、GGA、meta-GGA、hybrid、スピン分極、分子、周期バンド計算、励起は未実装。格子収束や独立な同一モデルとの一致は汎関数の物理精度を保証しない。KS固有値を一般の励起エネルギーと同一視しない。 周期He側では別のPySCFドライバーがVWN5相関と周期k点積分を扱う。
limitations.en: Atomic/molecular example scope: Separate exact-functional theory from the adopted Dirac exchange-only approximation. LDA correlation, GGA, meta-GGA, hybrids, spin polarization, molecules, periodic bands and excitations are not implemented. Grid convergence or agreement with an independent implementation of the same model does not establish functional accuracy. KS eigenvalues are not generally excitation energies. A separate PySCF periodic-He driver additionally uses VWN5 correlation and periodic k-point quadrature.

methods.units_ja: 原子・分子の実行例：原子単位系（ℏ=mₑ=e=4πε₀=1）。rはbohr、エネルギー・有効ポテンシャルはhartree、規格化した縮約軌道uはbohr⁻¹ᐟ²。正の電子数密度n(r)はbohr⁻³、動径電子数密度p(r)=4πr²n(r)はbohr⁻¹、∫p dr=N。pは符号付き電荷密度ではありません。 周期He：bohr・逆bohr・中性基本セル当たりhartree、逆格子での分率k座標。

caution.en: Distinguish exact-functional theory from calculations with approximate functionals. KS eigenvalues are not generally excitation energies; ground-state DFT alone does not guarantee excited-state accuracy.
